PILLI SUNIYAM

Worried About Pilli Suniyam?

Pilli Suniyam is a term used in Tamil spiritual traditions to describe what some people believe to be harmful spiritual influence. Repeated difficulties alone do not establish a supernatural cause.

COMMON QUESTIONS

Questions You May Have

How can I know whether I have Pilli Suniyam or Eval?

There is no scientifically established test that can confirm Pilli Suniyam or Eval. Experiences associated with spiritual causes can also have medical, psychological, relationship, financial or environmental explanations.

Will my problem be kept private?

Personal and family matters shared during a consultation are handled respectfully and confidentially.

Can I discuss family or relationship problems?

Yes. You can discuss family, relationship, personal, business, home or other concerns for which you seek traditional spiritual guidance.

Do you guarantee that my problem will be solved?

No responsible spiritual consultation should promise a guaranteed result. Spiritual guidance should not replace appropriate professional assistance where it is needed.
